chunk_findings.detail: The diff removes `agent` from the canonical record but leaves the record version at `"v": 1`, so old and new digests collide under the same version. A pre-change unspent approval row has `row["digest"]` computed from `{"v": 1, "agent": <requesting agent>, ...}`; after deploy, a successor lane re-running the exact same verb/item/target/args/state computes `{"v": 1, ...}` without `agent`, producing a different digest. The spend is rejected, the approval still expires, and the item remains stranded — precisely the B86be969daf failure this change claims to fix. The version must distinguish the schema (for example `"v": 2`) with a migration or v1 fallback, or retain `agent` for v1 records.

data.text:
B86be969daf approval spending: open a/b/c choice
OPEN (unsettled). A granted, unspent approval is owner-gated to its requesting agent and expires after use_ttl_s, so a lane that files+auto-approves then dies orphans the grant. The fix must settle among (a) bind the granted answer to the ACTION not the requesting agent so any successor lane of the same wave/coordinator may spend it, (b) lengthen the unspent use_ttl so a dead agent's grant outlives it, (c) reject the owner-gate premise and leave spending owner-gated; a and b are not mutually exclusive. The current branch implements (a) first (commit 98f9cf511) and re-derives the canonical-record version (6141c8794 then dd2464acf); the choice a-only vs a+b and the version-bump are still under review (3 untriaged findings).
